chunks: But they denied him and were seized by an earthquake, and lay overturned in their homes in the morning.

key_terms.جَاثِمِينَ: Prostrate or collapsed on their knees/shins

ai.seo_question: What was the punishment for the people who denied their prophet?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Ankabut, this verse highlights the sudden, physical destruction of those who rejected divine truth, serving as a tangible sign of God's power. Shia exegesis often interprets the 'rajfah' (earthquake) not merely as a natural phenomenon but as a direct, immediate consequence of their denial, emphasizing the inevitability of the Hereafter. This event underscores the theme of 'tadhakkur' (remembrance), urging believers to reflect on the fate of past nations to strengthen their own faith.
